note: Project Ana 2.0 registry + pointers. A character = this registry entry (name, id_prefix, default content country, TikTok @handle used by engine/scrape/tiktok_profile.js) + a Base References image set on Drive with her signature look baked in — there are NO per-character text files. 2.0 posts are framework posts (A/B/C/D per CONTRACT.md): the rotation (which framework + human/nohuman variant is next) is DERIVED from the character's fact tab on the shared Sheet via `engine/sheets/sheets.py next-slot --character <key> [--reserve]` — never stored here. Post IDs continue each account's 1.0 numbering (seeded as '(1.0 era marker)' rows by engine/setup/provision.py; the 1.0 Sheet/repo stay untouched as the archive). sheet_id + drive_setup_url are filled by provision.py. To add a character, run the new-character skill (.claude/skills/new-character/). 'holicay' is the FACELESS brand account: no persona, no character/Holicay/Base References, no chars/holicay_*.png — there is no faceless flag in 2.0 (faceless is a VARIANT: `nohuman`, and as of 2026-07-26 all four frameworks default to `human`, D included), so every `human` slot next-slot proposes for it is BUILT AND LOGGED AS `nohuman`. Its country 'Global' is a placeholder, not a sourcing subject: pass `--country <Country>` on next-slot and a real `--subject <country/city>` to brightdata.py for every Holicay post.
